scope: development world 0, exact reuse; two-stage presence-gate tuning (8 cells); selection rule frozen before stage 1
selection_rule: fewest sub-12 threshold-active slots with final median and novel 32-shot NMSE both <= 0.02; log loss breaks ties
outcome: NO SUFFICIENT COMPACT LIBRARY in either stage; the frozen rule rejected all eight cells
characterization: Stage 1 is bimodal: five cells prune nothing (12/12 active, novel-32 NMSE ~0.005); the strongest penalty collapses to one slot with broken accuracy (novel-32 0.078).
Stage 2 bisection finds an intermediate regime: penalty 5e-5 yields a 7-active-slot library (teacher has 6) with negligible lifetime-accuracy cost (median NMSE 0.0104 vs ~0.009 unpruned).

But both bisection cells fail novel-composition sufficiency (novel-32 ~0.033 vs limit 0.02) - including the 11-slot cell, so the degradation tracks the PENALTY, not the slot count: gate pressure itself damages compositional generality before pruning bites.
decision: Model 4 (MDL presence gating) is recorded as NOT WORKING as a compact-sufficient-library discoverer at this scale under the hard-concrete-style surrogate: configurations achieve either full slots with good novel transfer, or fewer slots with degraded novel transfer, never both. This satisfies the SPEC_AUDIT requirement for an explicit Model 4 decision. No further gate tuning; the result stands as a characterized negative.
relation_to_v2: Consistent with the premature-commitment picture (H7) and with consolidation-style approaches (V2 Model 8) that compress AFTER evidence accumulates rather than penalizing during learning.
